answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 64446 Country: India Title: Job related in NBFC Question: I am a commerce graduate. I have a question. “I got a job offer to work in NBFC Mahindra and Mahindra Finance Ltd. The job is that I have to work in the accounts Dept. People buy vehicles through bank finance (loan basis). I have to prepare all doc relating to it. Guide me whether I should join or quiet. Answer ID: 64446 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/653/M=07/1437) It is unlawful to help in a job which involves interest and sin. In the question mentioned above, if your task is to prepare the documents and papers of interest based dealing, then it is not acceptable, you should quit the job. If you fear to fall in unbearable troubles in case you quit the job immediately then keep on searching halal job. However, you may continue with this job due to compulsion until you find an alternate halal job, provided you will quit this job when you find a lawful job and keep on doing taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
